title: Classic Garlic Bagel
description: A delicious homemade bagel topped with crispy garlic butter.

steps.title: Prep the Dough
steps.instructionText: Prep the dough by mixing the flour and yeast in a bowl with warm water.
steps.importantTip: Make sure your dough ends up smooth and elastic. If it's too sticky, add a bit more flour. If it's too dry, add some water.

steps.title: Bake
steps.instructionText: Place on a baking sheet at 375°F (190°C) for 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Garlic Alfredo
description: Rich fettuccine pasta tossed in a rich, buttery garlic parmesan cream sauce.

steps.title: Boil Pasta
steps.instructionText: Boil fettuccine in salted water according to package instructions.

steps.title: Make Sauce
steps.instructionText: Melt butter, sauté garlic, then stir in heavy cream and parmesan until smooth.

title: Chicken & Veggie Stir Fry
description: Tender chicken breast slices sizzled with fresh broccoli, peppers, and savory soy glaze.

steps.title: Sear Chicken
steps.instructionText: Slice chicken thinly and cook in oil over high heat until browned.

steps.title: Toss Veggies & Sauce
steps.instructionText: Add broccoli, peppers, and soy sauce. Stir-fry until veggies are tender-crisp.

title: Street-Style Chicken Tacos
description: Warm corn tortillas loaded with spiced grilled chicken, diced onion, and fresh cilantro.

steps.title: Cook Chicken
steps.instructionText: Season chicken with taco seasoning and sear in a skillet over medium-high heat until fully cooked.
steps.importantTip: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before chopping to retain juices.

steps.title: Warm Tortillas & Assemble
steps.instructionText: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet, fill with chopped chicken, onions, cilantro, and squeeze fresh lime juice over top.

title: Cheesy Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Crispy golden tortillas stuffed with seasoned black beans, sweet corn, and melted jack cheese.

steps.title: Prepare Filling
steps.instructionText: Rinse black beans and mix with cumin and a spoonful of salsa in a bowl.

steps.title: Cook Quesadillas
steps.instructionText: Place filling and cheese inside folded tortillas and cook in a skillet on medium heat until golden brown on both sides.
steps.importantTip: Keep the heat at medium to allow the cheese to melt completely without burning the tortilla.

title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: Crispy homemade pizza crust topped with rich tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil leaves.

steps.title: Shape & Top Dough
steps.instructionText: Stretch dough onto a pizza pan, spread sauce evenly, and lay sliced fresh mozzarella on top.
steps.importantTip: Preheat your oven to its highest setting (475°F–500°F) for the crispiest crust.

steps.title: Bake & Garnish
steps.instructionText: Bake until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly, then top with fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Tuscan Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Juicy shrimp seared with sun-dried tomatoes and spinach in a creamy garlic white wine sauce.

steps.title: Sear Shrimp
steps.instructionText: Melt butter in a skillet and cook shrimp for 2 minutes per side until pink, then remove from pan.

steps.title: Simmer Sauce & Combine
steps.instructionText: Sauté garlic, add heavy cream and sun-dried tomatoes, toss in spinach until wilted, and stir shrimp back in.
steps.importantTip: Do not overcook the shrimp in the sauce to keep them tender.
